patch.value: state filter is applied client-side after --limit, under-returning on large teams

The Linear importer state flag was filtered CLIENT-SIDE in syncLinearIssues AFTER fetching limit issues, and buildIssuesQuery had no state clause, so import limit 100 state In Progress fetched 100 issues then dropped non-matching ones locally, under-returning matches beyond the fetched window on large teams. Fix: add server-side state.name.eq clause plus state variable in buildIssuesQuery, threaded through FetchFilters/buildImportRequestPlan/syncLinearIssues.
--state filters server-side via the GraphQL state.name.eq clause + variable; no clause when --state absent (zero regression); pure query-builder unit-tested
